description: Apply an effect to a clip, every clip on a track, or the whole timeline: picture effects (colour, LUT, blur, vignette, chroma key, glitch, denoise and more) on video, sound effects (EQ, compressor, noise_reduction, voice_denoise, pitch and more) on audio. Order matters: effects run in the order added (a track's before a clip's own). Picture numbers take keyframes, except glitch, denoise and chroma_key tolerance; sound params are constants. A wrong name or param is refused with the full list, ranges, units and defaults (also at video://catalog/effects); timeline.get shows every param applied. Returns its id as clip_id. Returns the edit result (see the server instructions).

clip_id.description: Apply to one clip (or an adjustment clip)

params.description: The effect's own params; any left out take their defaults. A wrong one is refused with the effect's params, ranges, units and defaults

preview.description: inline: image in the result; link: URI that renders on read; none

timeline.description: Or true for the whole picture or mix

timeline_id.description: Timeline handle; every edit returns a new one

track_id.description: Or to every clip on a track
